) format('woff2');unicode-range:U+0100-02BA,U+02BD-02C5,U+02C7-02CC,U+02CE-02D7,U+02DD-02FF,U+0304,U+0308,U+0329,U+1D00-1DBF,U+1E00-1E9F,U+1EF2-1EFF,U+2020,U+20A0-20AB,U+20AD-20C0,U+2113,U+2C60-2C7F,U+A720-A7FF}

@font-face{font-family:'Inter';font-style:normal;font-weight:700;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2');unicode-range:U+0100-02BA,U+02BD-02C5,U+02C7-02CC,U+02CE-02D7,U+02DD-02FF,U+0304,U+0308,U+0329,U+1D00-1DBF,U+1E00-1E9F,U+1EF2-1EFF,U+2020,U+20A0-20AB,U+20AD-20C0,U+2113,U+2C60-2C7F,U+A720-A7FF}

/* ===== DENEME: Amber tema (Tailwind benzeri) ===== */
:root,:root:not([data-theme="light"]){--bg:#F8FAFC;--card:#fff;--text:#1e293b;--muted:#94a3b8;--border:#e2e8f0;--accent:#F59E0B;--accent-soft:#FFFBEB;--hover:#f1f5f9;--neg:#dc2626;--shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,.04)}
body{font-family:'Inter',system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Arial,sans-serif;display:flex;min-height:100vh;color-scheme:light}
.wrap{flex:1;max-width:none;margin:0;padding:0 32px 48px;min-width:0}
header{display:none}
#side{width:256px;flex:none;background:#fff;border-right:1px solid var(--border);padding:16px;position:sticky;top:0;height:100vh;box-sizing:border-box;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;overflow:auto}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:10px 8px;margin-bottom:22px}
.brand .bl{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--accent);color:#fff;font-weight:800;font-size:20px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;box-shadow:0 6px 14px -4px rgba(245,158,11,.5)}
.brand b{display:block;font-size:17px;color:#0f172a;line-height:1.2}.brand small{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:500}
.sec{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);padding:0 12px;margin-bottom:8px}
#tabs{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;border:0;margin:0}
#tabs button{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;width:100%;text-align:left;padding:10px 14px;border:0;border-radius:12px;margin:0;font-weight:500;font-size:14px;color:#475569;background:none;transition:all .15s}
#tabs button:hover{background:#f1f5f9}
#tabs button.on{background:var(--accent);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 6px 14px -4px rgba(245,158,11,.55)}
#tabs svg{width:16px;height:16px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;flex:none}
.prof{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding-top:14px;border-top:1px solid #f1f5f9}
.prof .av{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;background:#0f172a;color:#fff;font-weight:700;font-size:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.prof b{display:block;font-size:14px;color:#1e293b}.prof small{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
#topbar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:22px 0 18px;margin-bottom:18px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(226,232,240,.7);gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.crumb{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:14px;color:#64748b}.crumb i{font-style:normal;color:#cbd5e1}.crumb b{color:#1e293b;font-weight:600}
.tb-r{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.sbox{position:relative;width:320px}.sbox input{width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;padding:9px 40px 9px 14px;font:inherit;font-size:14px}
.sbox input:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(245,158,11,.18)}
.gsdrop{display:none;position:absolute;right:0;top:calc(100% + 8px);width:min(620px,92vw);max-height:72vh;overflow:auto;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;box-shadow:0 18px 44px rgba(15,23,42,.18);z-index:60;padding:6px 0}
.gsdrop .gsh{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:10px 16px 4px;font:700 11px Inter,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.gsdrop .gsi{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:8px 16px;cursor:pointer;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.35}
.gsdrop .gsi:hover,.gsdrop .gsi.on{background:#fff7e6}.gsdrop .gsi b{font-weight:700}.gsdrop .gsi small{color:var(--muted);display:block;font-size:12px}
.gsdrop .gsr{white-space:nowrap;text-align:right;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.gsdrop .gsall{margin:6px 10px 4px;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:10px;background:#fff7e6;border:1px solid #fcd9a0;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;font-size:13.5px}
.gsdrop .gse{padding:18px 16px;color:var(--muted);font-size:13.5px}
.ozhead.gexp{position:relative;display:block;padding:0 170px}.ozhead.gexp .gexpb{position:absolute;right:0;top:0;display:flex;gap:8px}.gexpb .ghost{white-space:nowrap;border:1px solid var(--accent);background:var(--accent);color:#fff;border-radius:9px;padding:7px 14px;font:700 12.5px Inter,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 6px 14px -6px rgba(245,158,11,.55)}.gexpb .ghost:hover{filter:brightness(.94)}@media(max-width:900px){.ozhead.gexp{padding:0}.ozhead.gexp .gexpb{position:static;justify-content:center;margin-top:10px}}
.sbox kbd{position:absolute;right:10px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);font:700 11px Inter,sans-serif;color:var(--muted);background:#f1f5f9;border-radius:5px;padding:2px 6px}
.dchip{font-size:12px;color:#64748b;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;padding:9px 12px}
.card,.kpi{border-radius:16px;border-color:rgba(226,232,240,.85)}
.kpis>.kpi:first-child{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 12px 24px -10px rgba(245,158,11,.55)}
.kpis>.kpi:first-child .l,.kpis>.kpi:first-child .s{color:#FEF3C7}
.kpi .l{font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.06em}
th{background:#f8fafc;color:#94a3b8;font-weight:700}
.btn.primary,.seg button.on,.chipbtn.on{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:#fff}
.btn{border-radius:12px;font-weight:600}
.tag{background:#fef3c7;color:#92400e;border:1px solid #fde68a;border-radius:999px;padding:2px 10px;font-weight:600;font-size:11px}
.tag.neg{background:#fee2e2;color:#b91c1c;border-color:#fecaca}.tag.warn{background:#fef3c7;color:#92400e;border-color:#fde68a}
.cgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(210px,1fr));gap:14px;margin-top:10px}
.ccard{background:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(226,232,240,.85);border-radius:16px;padding:18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;transition:all .15s}
.ccard:hover{box-shadow:0 8px 20px -8px rgba(15,23,42,.18);border-color:#fbbf24}
.ctop{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:14px}
.mono{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:12px;color:#fff;font-weight:800;font-size:20px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(15,23,42,.15)}
.ctop .arr{color:#cbd5e1;font-size:18px}.ccard:hover .arr{color:var(--accent)}
.ccard h3{margin:0;font-size:15px;color:#0f172a}.ccard p{margin:2px 0 0;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:500}
.ccard .cv{font-size:22px;font-weight:800;color:#0f172a;margin-top:14px}.ccard small{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}
.cbtn{margin-top:14px;width:100%;padding:8px;border:0;border-radius:12px;background:#f8fafc;color:#334155;font:inherit;font-weight:600;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s}
.ccard:hover .cbtn{background:var(--accent);color:#fff}
.rulebar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;align-items:center}.rulebar select,.rulebar input{background:#f8fafc;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;padding:9px 12px;font:inherit;font-size:14px}.rulebar input{flex:1;min-width:240px}
.rulebar .add{background:#fef3c7;color:#92400e;border:0;border-radius:12px;padding:9px 16px;font:inherit;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}.rulebar .add:hover{background:#fde68a}
@media (max-width:900px){body{flex-direction:column}#side{width:100%;height:auto;position:static;border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}#tabs{flex-direction:row;flex-wrap:wrap}#tabs button{width:auto}.prof{display:none}.wrap{padding:0 14px 40px}.sbox{width:100%}}

/* ===== TİPOGRAFİ SİSTEMİ (tüm sayfalar): 11 / 12 / 13 / 14 / 16 / 20 / 28 px · 400 / 600 / 700 ===== */
body,input,select,button,textarea,table,kbd,th,td{font-family:'Inter',system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Arial,sans-serif}
body{font-size:14px;font-weight:400;line-height:1.5}
.p2intro h2{font-size:20px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.card h2,.detailhead h2,.ozhead h2,.ccard h3,.dshead h2{font-size:16px;font-weight:700}
.kpi .v,.v,.big{font-size:20px;font-weight:700}
.ozbig{font-size:28px;font-weight:700}
.ccard .cv,.mono{font-size:20px;font-weight:700}
#gt_kurum th,#gt_kurum td,#gt_kurum th.r,#gt_kurum td.r,#gt_detail th,#gt_detail td,#gt_detail th.r,#gt_detail td.r{text-align:center;vertical-align:middle}
#gt_kurum th,#gt_detail th{white-space:normal;line-height:1.3}
.mono.logo{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;box-shadow:none;padding:5px}
.mono.logo img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;display:block}
.mono.sm{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:10px;font-size:14px;flex:none}
th{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.04em}
.arr,kbd{font-size:11px;font-weight:700}
.ccard .arr{font-size:16px;font-weight:400}
.dchip,.s,.gray,.note,.disc,small,.ccard p{font-size:12px;font-weight:400}
.chip,.chipbtn,.cbtn,.lv{font-size:12px;font-weight:600}
.tag{font-size:11px;font-weight:600}
.hv,.kv,label.tog{font-size:13px}
button,.btn,.seg button,.add{font-size:14px;font-weight:600}
.dscnt{display:inline-block;background:#f1f5f9;color:#475569;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;border-radius:8px;padding:2px 10px;margin-left:8px;vertical-align:middle}
.badge{font-size:11px}
.kpis.sm .kpi .v{font-size:16px}
.kpi.mini .v{font-size:20px}
/* detaylı arama */
.dscard{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;padding:22px}
.dshead{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.dst{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}.dst svg{width:22px;height:22px;fill:none;stroke:#475569;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round}
.dsrow{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;align-items:flex-end}
.dsrow label{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:#334155;min-width:200px}
.dsrow label.grow{flex:1;min-width:260px}.dsrow label.grow>span:last-child{display:block}
.dsrow select,.dsrow input[type=text],.dsrow input:not([type=checkbox]){width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;padding:13px 14px;font:inherit;font-size:14px;font-weight:400;color:#1e293b}
.dsrow select:focus,.dsrow input:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(245,158,11,.18)}
.dsrow label.chk{flex-direction:row;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-weight:400;color:#475569;min-width:0;padding-bottom:12px}.dsrow label.chk input{accent-color:var(--accent);width:18px;height:18px}
.add{background:#F5B83D;color:#1f2937;border:0;border-radius:14px;padding:13px 22px;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap}.add:hover{background:#F2AE22}
.dsline{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;color:#64748b;font-size:12px;margin-top:6px}.dsline::after{content:"";flex:1;height:1px;background:#eef2f6}
#ds_rules{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.fcell{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-width:250px}.fcell b{display:block;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:#0f172a}.fcell .fn{font-size:12px;color:#64748b;text-transform:uppercase;max-width:300px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.mt{font-size:12px;color:#64748b}

/* ===== KPI kartları: içerik dikey ortalı, ilk kartta büyük değer ===== */
.kpi{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:2px}
.kpis>.kpi:first-child .v{font-size:28px;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.kpis>.kpi:first-child .l{font-size:12px}
/* ===== Halka grafik görünümü ===== */
.slice,.fslice,.yslice{stroke:var(--card);stroke-width:3px;stroke-linejoin:round;filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 4px rgba(15,23,42,.14));transition:opacity .15s,transform .15s,filter .15s;transform-origin:150px 150px}
.slice:hover,.fslice:hover,.yslice:hover{transform:scale(1.03);filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 8px rgba(15,23,42,.22)) brightness(1.04)}
svg.donut{filter:drop-shadow(0 6px 14px rgba(15,23,42,.06))}

/* ===== Genel Bakış: ödeme takvimi kartı ortalı ===== */
#tasfList .detailhead{justify-content:center;text-align:center}
#page1 table th,#page1 table td,#page1 table th.r,#page1 table td.r,#page2 table th,#page2 table td,#page2 table th.r,#page2 table td.r{text-align:center;vertical-align:middle}
#page1 table th,#page2 table th{white-space:normal;line-height:1.3}
#page1 table td b,#page2 table td b{display:inline}
#oz_od .ozhead{flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;gap:4px}
#oz_ost .ozhead{flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;gap:4px}
#oz_od .detailhead{flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;gap:6px}
#oz_ost .detailhead{flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;gap:6px}
#oz_od th,#oz_od td,#oz_od th.r,#oz_od td.r{text-align:center}
#oz_ost th,#oz_ost td,#oz_ost th.r,#oz_ost td.r{text-align:center}
#oz_od td.r b,#oz_od td b{display:inline}
#oz_ost td.r b,#oz_ost td b{display:inline}
#oz_yp th,#oz_yp td,#oz_yp th.r,#oz_yp td.r{text-align:center;vertical-align:middle}
#oz_yp td.r b,#oz_yp td b{display:inline}
#oz_yp .ozhead{text-align:center}#oz_yp .ozhead h2,#oz_yp .ozhead .gray{text-align:center}#oz_yp table{font-size:11.5px}#oz_yp th,#oz_yp td{padding:5px 6px!important;line-height:1.25}#oz_yp th{font-size:10.5px}#oz_yp td{white-space:nowrap}.ypbar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin:2px 0 12px}.ypl{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted,#78716c)}.ypdd{position:relative}.yppan{position:absolute;z-index:30;top:calc(100% + 6px);left:0;min-width:200px;max-height:300px;overflow:auto;background:var(--card,#fff);border:1px solid var(--line,#d6d3d1);border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 14px 30px -10px rgba(0,0,0,.25);padding:8px;text-align:left}.yppan label{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;padding:6px 8px;border-radius:8px;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer}.yppan label:hover{background:rgba(245,158,11,.12)}.yppan input{accent-color:var(--accent,#f59e0b)}.yppanh{display:flex;gap:6px;padding:2px 2px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#e7e5e4);margin-bottom:6px}.yppanh button{flex:1;border:1px solid var(--line,#d6d3d1);background:transparent;color:inherit;border-radius:8px;padding:5px 6px;font:600 11.5px Inter,sans-serif;cursor:pointer}.ypsep{width:1px;height:20px;background:var(--line,#e7e5e4);margin:0 6px}.ypchk,.ypy{border:1px solid var(--line,#d6d3d1);background:var(--card,#fff);color:inherit;border-radius:999px;padding:6px 14px;font:600 12.5px Inter,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;gap:6px;align-items:center}.ypchk input{accent-color:var(--accent,#f59e0b);margin:0}.ypchk.on,.ypy.on{background:var(--accent,#f59e0b);border-color:var(--accent,#f59e0b);color:#fff}#oz_yp td:first-child{white-space:normal;min-width:130px;max-width:170px}#oz_yp th{white-space:normal!important;min-width:0!important;max-width:88px;line-height:1.15}#oz_yp th:first-child{max-width:150px}#oz_yp table{width:100%}#oz_yp th,#oz_yp td{padding:5px 3px!important}#oz_yp td{font-size:11px}
#oz_od th{white-space:normal;line-height:1.3}
#oz_ost th{white-space:normal;line-height:1.3}
#oz_od th,#oz_od td{padding-left:8px;padding-right:8px}
#oz_ost th,#oz_ost td{padding-left:8px;padding-right:8px}
#oz_od td{vertical-align:middle}
#oz_ost td{vertical-align:middle}
#oz_od .od-d.dur-no,.dur-no{color:#d92d3a!important;font-weight:700}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]) #oz_od .od-d.dur-no,:root:not([data-theme="light"]) .dur-no{color:#ff6b73!important}}
:root[data-theme="dark"] #oz_od .od-d.dur-no,:root[data-theme="dark"] .dur-no{color:#ff6b73!important}
#oz_od .od-d{display:inline-block;max-width:210px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.35;color:#475569}
#oz_od td:first-child{min-width:150px}


/* ===== BİST RASYO ANALİZİ ===== */
#page_ra th,#page_ra td{text-align:center}
#page_ra td.desc{max-width:340px;color:var(--text)}
#page_ra td.ra-u{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);min-width:240px;max-width:320px}
#page_ra td.desc{min-width:260px}
#page_ra td.ra-s{min-width:160px}
#page_ra td.ra-e{min-width:170px}
.ra-top{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-end;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:14px}
.ra-top .p2intro{margin:0}
.ra-kap{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-top:8px}
.ra-kap span{background:#f1f5f9;color:#475569;border-radius:999px;padding:3px 10px;font-size:12px}
.ra-srch{position:relative;width:300px;max-width:100%}
.ra-srch input{width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;padding:9px 12px;font:inherit;background:var(--card);color:var(--text)}
.ra-srch input:focus{outline:none;border-color:#f59e0b;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(245,158,11,.15)}
.ra-dd{display:none;position:absolute;right:0;left:0;top:calc(100% + 6px);background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(15,23,42,.14);z-index:50;max-height:380px;overflow:auto;padding:4px 0}
.ra-dd.on{display:block}
.ra-dd button{display:flex;width:100%;gap:10px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;border:0;background:none;padding:8px 12px;cursor:pointer;font:inherit;color:var(--text);text-align:left}
.ra-dd button:hover{background:var(--hover)}
.ra-dd .gray{font-size:12px}
.ra-tabs{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:0 0 16px}
.ra-tabs button{font:inherit;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--card);color:#475569;border-radius:999px;padding:8px 16px;cursor:pointer}
.ra-tabs button:hover{background:var(--hover)}
.ra-tabs button.on{background:#fff4e0;border-color:#f59e0b;color:#b45309}
#page_ra .card{margin-bottom:16px}
#page_ra .card h2{margin:0}
.ra-sub{color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;margin:4px 0 12px}
.ra-h{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:6px}
/* risk sınıfı rozetleri */
.rcl{display:inline-block;border-radius:999px;padding:2px 10px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap}
.c-g{background:#fde2e7;color:#9f1239}.c-y{background:#ffe7d6;color:#c2410c}.c-o{background:#fef3c7;color:#a16207}.c-d{background:#dcfce7;color:#15803d}.c-b{background:#e0e7ff;color:#4338ca}
.b-g{background:#e11d48}.b-y{background:#f97316}.b-o{background:#f5b524}.b-d{background:#34c37a}.b-b{background:#818cf8}
/* rasyo hücreleri */
.rv{display:inline-block;min-width:62px;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:8px;font-weight:600;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;white-space:nowrap}
.p0{background:#e6f7ed;color:#15803d}.p50{background:#fff4d1;color:#a16207}.p100{background:#fde6e6;color:#b91c1c}.pn{background:#f1f5f9;color:#64748b}
.ra-sc{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.ra-scb{display:inline-block;width:64px;height:7px;border-radius:999px;background:#eef2f6;overflow:hidden}
.ra-scb i{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:999px}
/* dağılım çubuğu */
.ra-dist{display:flex;height:12px;border-radius:999px;overflow:hidden;background:#eef2f6;min-width:120px}
.ra-dist i{display:block;height:100%}
.ra-dist.big{height:18px;margin:14px 0 6px}
.ra-leg{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);justify-content:center}
.ra-leg b{display:inline-block;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:3px;margin-right:5px;vertical-align:-1px}
/* KPI kutuları */
.ra-k5{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px}
.ra-kp{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;padding:14px;background:var(--card);text-align:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.ra-kp.cl{cursor:pointer}.ra-kp.cl:hover{background:var(--hover)}
.ra-kp:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:0;height:4px;background:#cbd5e1}
.ra-kp.k-g:before{background:#e11d48}.ra-kp.k-y:before{background:#f97316}.ra-kp.k-o:before{background:#f5b524}.ra-kp.k-d:before{background:#34c37a}.ra-kp.k-a:before{background:#f59e0b}
.ra-kp .l{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;line-height:1.3}
.ra-kp .v{font-size:26px;font-weight:700;margin-top:6px;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.ra-kp .s{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:2px}
@media(max-width:1000px){.ra-k5{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
/* öne çıkanlar */
.ra-ob{margin:6px 0 0;padding:0;list-style:none;display:grid;gap:8px}
.ra-ob li{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;background:#fbfcfe;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;padding:10px 12px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5}
.ra-ob li:before{content:"";flex:0 0 8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#f59e0b;margin-top:7px}
/* sektör çubukları */
.ra-sbg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));column-gap:28px}
@media(max-width:1000px){.ra-sbg{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.ra-sb{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(150px,240px) 1fr 56px;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:5px 6px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px}
.ra-sb:hover{background:var(--hover)}
.ra-sb .t{white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;text-align:left}
.ra-sb .bar{height:10px;border-radius:999px;background:#eef2f6;overflow:hidden}.ra-sb .bar i{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:999px}
.ra-sb b{text-align:right}
.ra-chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px;justify-content:center}
.ra-chip{display:inline-block;border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--card);border-radius:999px;padding:1px 8px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;color:var(--text)}
.ra-chip:hover{border-color:#f59e0b;color:#b45309}
.ra-ev{display:inline-block;background:#fff1f2;color:#9f1239;border-radius:8px;padding:3px 8px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.4}
/* filtre çubuğu */
.ra-fb{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin:4px 0 12px}
.ra-fb .rcl{cursor:pointer;opacity:.45;border:1px solid transparent;padding:5px 12px}
.ra-fb .rcl.on{opacity:1;border-color:currentColor}
.ra-fb select{font:inherit;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:6px 10px;background:var(--card);color:var(--text);max-width:280px}
.ra-fb label{display:inline-flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;font-size:13px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:999px;padding:5px 12px;cursor:pointer;background:var(--card)}
.ra-fb .sep{width:1px;height:22px;background:var(--border)}
.ra-legend{display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:12px;margin:0 0 10px;color:var(--muted)}
/* sektör detay */
.ra-sd{border:1px solid #fde7b0;background:#fffcf5;border-radius:14px;padding:14px;margin-top:14px}
/* yöntem tabloları */
.ra-mt{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:13px}
.ra-mt th{background:#f8fafc}
.ra-mt td,.ra-mt th{border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);padding:8px 10px;vertical-align:middle}
.ra-mt td.l{text-align:left}
.ra-ap{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}.ra-ap span{display:inline-block;width:70px;height:7px;border-radius:999px;background:#eef2f6;overflow:hidden}.ra-ap span i{display:block;height:100%;background:#f87171}
.ra-cls3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;margin-top:8px}
.ra-cls3>div{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;padding:10px;text-align:center;font-size:13px}
@media(max-width:900px){.ra-cls3{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
.ra-codes{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;justify-content:center;margin-top:6px}
.ra-codes span{background:#f1f5f9;border-radius:8px;padding:2px 8px;font-size:12px}
/* şirket kartı (modal) */
#ra_m{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(15,23,42,.38);display:none;z-index:900;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;padding:4vh 16px;overflow:auto}
#ra_m.on{display:flex}
#ra_mb{background:var(--card);color:var(--text);border-radius:18px;width:min(1080px,100%);box-shadow:0 24px 70px rgba(15,23,42,.28);padding:20px 22px 22px}
.ra-mh{display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);padding-bottom:14px;margin-bottom:14px}
.ra-code{font-size:26px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.01em}
.ra-mh .sp{flex:1}
.ra-big{text-align:center;min-width:120px}
.ra-big .n{font-size:30px;font-weight:800;line-height:1}
.ra-big .ra-scb{width:110px;height:8px;margin-top:6px}
.ra-big .gray{font-size:11px}
.ra-x{font:inherit;border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--card);border-radius:10px;padding:7px 12px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--text)}
.ra-x:hover{background:var(--hover)}
.ra-meta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-top:6px}
.ra-meta span{background:#f1f5f9;border-radius:999px;padding:2px 10px;font-size:12px;color:#475569}
.ra-evb{background:#fff1f2;border:1px solid #fecdd3;color:#881337;border-radius:12px;padding:10px 14px;margin-bottom:12px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5}
.ra-evb.b{background:#eef2ff;border-color:#c7d2fe;color:#3730a3}
.ra-uy{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-bottom:14px}
.ra-uy span{background:#fff7ed;color:#c2410c;border:1px solid #fed7aa;border-radius:999px;padding:3px 10px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600}
.ra-st{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:#475569;margin:16px 0 8px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em}
.ra-rg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}
@media(max-width:900px){.ra-rg{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
.ra-rc{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;padding:10px 12px;text-align:center}
.ra-rc .n{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}
.ra-rc .rv{font-size:17px;margin:6px 0 4px;min-width:90px}
.ra-rc .t{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.45}
.ra-rc .pl{display:block;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;margin-top:4px}
.ra-fg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px}
@media(max-width:900px){.ra-fg{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.ra-ft{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden}
.ra-ft h4{margin:0;padding:8px 12px;background:#f8fafc;font-size:13px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);text-align:center}
.ra-ft table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:13px}
.ra-ft td{padding:6px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.ra-ft tr:last-child td{border-bottom:0}
.ra-ft td:first-child{text-align:left;color:var(--muted)}
.ra-ft td:last-child{text-align:right;font-weight:600;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.ra-ft .neg{color:#dc2626}
.ra-fh{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;padding:10px 12px}
.ra-fh .row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:70px 1fr 130px;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:5px 0;border-bottom:1px dashed var(--border);font-size:13px;cursor:pointer}
.ra-fh .row:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.ra-fh .row:hover{background:var(--hover)}
.ra-fh .row span{text-align:left;color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]) #page_ra .p0,:root:not([data-theme="light"]) #ra_m .p0{background:rgba(52,195,122,.16);color:#6ee7a6}
:root:not([data-theme="light"]) #page_ra .p50,:root:not([data-theme="light"]) #ra_m .p50{background:rgba(245,181,36,.16);color:#fcd34d}
:root:not([data-theme="light"]) #page_ra .p100,:root:not([data-theme="light"]) #ra_m .p100{background:rgba(248,113,113,.16);color:#fca5a5}
:root:not([data-theme="light"]) .ra-ob li,:root:not([data-theme="light"]) .ra-sd,:root:not([data-theme="light"]) .ra-ft h4,:root:not([data-theme="light"]) .ra-mt th,:root:not([data-theme="light"]) .ra-kap span,:root:not([data-theme="light"]) .ra-meta span,:root:not([data-theme="light"]) .ra-codes span{background:var(--hover);color:var(--text)}}
:root[data-theme="dark"] #page_ra .p0,:root[data-theme="dark"] #ra_m .p0{background:rgba(52,195,122,.16);color:#6ee7a6}
:root[data-theme="dark"] #page_ra .p50,:root[data-theme="dark"] #ra_m .p50{background:rgba(245,181,36,.16);color:#fcd34d}
:root[data-theme="dark"] #page_ra .p100,:root[data-theme="dark"] #ra_m .p100{background:rgba(248,113,113,.16);color:#fca5a5}
:root[data-theme="dark"] .ra-ob li,:root[data-theme="dark"] .ra-sd,:root[data-theme="dark"] .ra-ft h4,:root[data-theme="dark"] .ra-mt th,:root[data-theme="dark"] .ra-kap span,:root[data-theme="dark"] .ra-meta span,:root[data-theme="dark"] .ra-codes span{background:var(--hover);color:var(--text)}
.ra-mh>div:first-child{flex:1 1 380px;min-width:0}.ra-mh .sp{display:none}

/* başlıklar ortalı */
#page_ra .card>h2,#page_ra .card>.ra-sub,#page_ra .ra-st,#ra_m .ra-st{text-align:center}
#page_ra .ozhead.gexp{text-align:center}
#page_ra .ozhead.gexp>div:first-child{text-align:center}
#page_ra .ra-h{position:relative;display:block;text-align:center}
#page_ra .ra-h>div:first-child{text-align:center}
#page_ra .ra-h>div+div{position:absolute;right:0;top:0}
#page_ra .ra-h:has(>div+div){padding:0 280px}
@media(max-width:900px){#page_ra .ra-h:has(>div+div){padding:0}#page_ra .ra-h>div+div{position:static;justify-content:center;margin-top:10px}}
.ra-kp .l{min-height:2.6em;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}

.tnote{background:#fff8eb;border:1px solid #fde7b0;border-radius:12px;padding:10px 14px;margin:0 0 14px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.55;color:#7c5a12}.tnote div+div{margin-top:4px}
.ra-disc{margin:18px 0 6px;padding:12px 16px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;background:#f8fafc;color:#64748b;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.6;text-align:center}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]) .tnote{background:rgba(245,158,11,.1);border-color:rgba(245,158,11,.3);color:#fcd34d}:root:not([data-theme="light"]) .ra-disc{background:var(--hover)}}
.oztop3 .ozhead{min-height:4.4em;align-items:flex-start}

.tsh{position:relative;text-align:center;margin:6px 2px 12px}.tsh .ozlink{position:absolute;right:4px;bottom:2px}@media(max-width:900px){.tsh .ozlink{position:static;margin-top:6px}}.tsh h2{margin:0;font-size:16px}.tsh .gray{font-size:12.5px;margin-top:2px}
.oztop3 .card.tc{position:relative;overflow:hidden;text-align:center;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-start;padding:18px 16px 16px;gap:0}
.tc:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:0;height:4px;background:#cbd5e1}
.k1:before{background:#94a3b8}.k2:before{background:#60a5fa}.k3:before{background:#f59e0b}.k4:before{background:#34c37a}
.tc-top{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.tc-d{display:inline-block;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.02em;padding:3px 12px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--hover);color:var(--text)}
.k3 .tc-d{background:#fff4e0;color:#b45309}.k4 .tc-d{background:#e6f7ed;color:#15803d}
.tc-l{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em}
.tc-v{font-size:32px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:10px 0 6px;line-height:1.1}.tc-v small{font-size:17px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted)}
.tc-s{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.5}.tc-s b{color:var(--text)}
.tc-f{margin-top:auto;padding-top:10px;border-top:1px dashed var(--border);width:100%;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.5}.tc-f b{color:var(--text)}
.oztop3 .card.tc>.tc-s+.tc-f{margin-top:auto}
.tc-s{margin-bottom:12px}
.tc-neg{color:#dc2626;font-weight:700}.tc-pc{color:var(--muted)}
.tc-pr{text-align:left}.tc-prh{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}.tc-prh b{color:var(--text)}
.tc-bar{height:8px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--hover);overflow:hidden;margin:6px 0}.tc-bar i{display:block;height:100%;background:#34c37a;border-radius:999px}
.tc-prs{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.45}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]) .k3 .tc-d{background:rgba(245,158,11,.15);color:#fcd34d}:root:not([data-theme="light"]) .k4 .tc-d{background:rgba(52,195,122,.15);color:#6ee7a6}}
/* ===== v2 görsel iyileştirmeler ===== */
body{font-feature-settings:"tnum" 1,"cv11" 1;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
td,th,.v,.tc-v,.big{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
/* Sayfa geçişi */
section[id^=page_]{animation:v2fade .28s ease}
@keyframes v2fade{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
/* Kart başlıkları: ortalı, ince vurgu çizgisi */
.card>h2,.card .ozhead h2,.card .detailhead h2{position:relative}
.card>h2{text-align:center;padding-bottom:10px;margin-bottom:14px}
.card>h2:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:0;width:36px;height:3px;border-radius:3px;background:#fcd9a0;transform:translateX(-50%)}
/* KPI kartları: Genel Bakış'taki tasfiye kartlarıyla aynı dil */
.kpis>.kpi,.kpis>.kpi:first-child{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:var(--card);color:var(--text);border:1px solid var(--border);box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,.04),0 6px 18px -12px rgba(15,23,42,.18);text-align:center;align-items:center;padding:18px 14px 14px}
.kpis>.kpi:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:0;height:4px;background:#cbd5e1}
.kpis>.kpi:nth-child(1):before{background:#f59e0b}.kpis>.kpi:nth-child(2):before{background:#60a5fa}
.kpis>.kpi:nth-child(3):before{background:#a78bfa}.kpis>.kpi:nth-child(4):before{background:#34c37a}
.kpis>.kpi:nth-child(5):before{background:#f472b6}.kpis>.kpi:nth-child(6):before{background:#2dd4bf}
.kpis>.kpi:first-child .l,.kpis>.kpi .l{color:var(--muted);font-size:11.5px}
.kpis>.kpi:first-child .s,.kpis>.kpi .s{color:var(--muted)}
.kpis>.kpi:first-child .v,.kpis>.kpi .v{font-size:26px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin-top:6px;color:var(--text)}
.kpis>.kpi:first-child .v{color:#b45309}
.kpis>.kpi{transition:transform .15s,box-shadow .15s}
.kpis>.kpi:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 10px 24px -14px rgba(15,23,42,.3)}
/* Tasfiye kartlarına hafif hover */
.oztop3 .card.tc{transition:transform .15s,box-shadow .15s}
.oztop3 .card.tc:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 12px 26px -16px rgba(15,23,42,.35)}
/* Tablolar: daha derli toplu satırlar, zebra, yumuşak başlık */
table th{background:#f8fafc;color:#64748b;font-weight:700;font-size:10.5px;line-height:1.3;vertical-align:middle}
.gts thead tr:first-child th{border-bottom:1px solid #e2e8f0}
table td{padding:7px 10px;line-height:1.35;vertical-align:middle}
table tbody tr:nth-child(even) td{background:#fcfcfd}
table tbody tr:hover td{background:#fff8eb}
tr.sel td,tr.hl td{background:#fff4e0!important}
.scroll,.tablewrap{scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:#cbd5e1 transparent}
.scroll::-webkit-scrollbar,.tablewrap::-webkit-scrollbar{height:8px;width:8px}
.scroll::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb,.tablewrap::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:#cbd5e1;border-radius:8px}
/* Bilgi notu: sol vurgu çizgisi */
.tnote{border-left:4px solid #f59e0b;border-radius:10px}
/* Kart gölgeleri ve kenarlar */
.card{box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,.04),0 8px 22px -16px rgba(15,23,42,.22)}
/* Menü: seçili sayfa vurgusu */
#tabs button{transition:background .15s,color .15s}
/* Veri tarihi rozeti */
.v2date{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:#15803d;background:#e6f7ed;border:1px solid #c6ecd6;border-radius:999px;padding:4px 11px;margin-right:10px;white-space:nowrap}
.v2date i{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:#22c55e;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(34,197,94,.2)}
/* Sayfa üst başlığı ortalı */
.p2intro{justify-content:center;text-align:center}
.p2intro h2{font-size:22px;letter-spacing:-.02em}
/* Yazdırma: menü gizli, kartlar bölünmez */
@media print{
  #side,#topbar,.gexpb,.ghost,.tsh .ozlink,.ozlink{display:none!important}
  body{background:#fff}.wrap{max-width:none;padding:0}
  .card,.kpi{box-shadow:none!important;break-inside:avoid}
  .scroll{max-height:none!important;overflow:visible!important}
  section[id^=page_]{animation:none}
}
/* Ödeme takvimi tabloları: kompakt, tek satıra yakın */
#oz_od table,#oz_ost table,#oz_yp table{font-size:12.5px}
#oz_od td,#oz_ost td,#oz_yp td{padding:6px 8px;line-height:1.3}
#oz_od td:nth-child(-n+2),#oz_ost td:nth-child(-n+2){min-width:170px}
#oz_od td:first-child,#oz_ost td:first-child,#oz_yp td:first-child{font-weight:600}
.tc-pc,.tc-neg{white-space:nowrap}
/* Alt iki kart eşit boy */
#oz_kt,#oz_tas2{height:100%}
/* Yığılmış dağılım çubukları daha belirgin */
#oz_var .oztrack,#oz_yog .oztrack{height:14px;border-radius:7px}
/* Genel Bakış alt kart başlıkları ortalı; bağlantı sağda */
.ozhead:not(.gexp){position:relative;justify-content:center;text-align:center;padding:0 120px}
.ozhead:not(.gexp) .sp{display:none}
.ozhead:not(.gexp) .ozlink{position:absolute;right:0;top:2px}
@media(max-width:900px){.ozhead:not(.gexp){padding:0}.ozhead:not(.gexp) .ozlink{position:static}}
#oz_var .ozleg,#oz_yog .ozleg{justify-content:center}
/* Tek renk: turuncu */
.oztop3 .tc:before,.k1:before,.k2:before,.k3:before,.k4:before{background:#F59E0B!important}
.oztop3 .tc-d,.k1 .tc-d,.k2 .tc-d,.k3 .tc-d,.k4 .tc-d{background:#FFF4E0!important;color:#B45309!important}
.tc-neg{color:#B45309}
.tc-bar i{background:#F59E0B}
.kpis>.kpi:before{background:#F59E0B!important}
.kpis>.kpi .v,.kpis>.kpi:first-child .v{color:var(--text)}
/* Kompakt kartlar */
.oztop3{gap:12px!important}
.oztop3 .card.tc{padding:12px 12px 10px!important;border-radius:14px}
.oztop3 .tc:before{height:3px}
.tc-top{gap:4px}
.tc-d{font-size:11px;padding:2px 10px}
.tc-l{font-size:10.5px}
.tc-v{font-size:23px;margin:6px 0 4px}.tc-v small{font-size:13px}
.tc-s{font-size:12px;line-height:1.4;margin-bottom:8px}
.tc-f{font-size:11px;padding-top:7px;line-height:1.4}
.tc-prh{font-size:11px}.tc-bar{height:6px;margin:4px 0}.tc-prs{font-size:11px}
.kpis{gap:12px}
.kpis>.kpi,.kpis>.kpi:first-child{padding:11px 12px 10px;border-radius:14px}
.kpis>.kpi:before{height:3px}
.kpis>.kpi .l,.kpis>.kpi:first-child .l{font-size:10.5px}
.kpis>.kpi .v,.kpis>.kpi:first-child .v{font-size:20px;margin-top:3px}
.kpis>.kpi .s,.kpis>.kpi:first-child .s{font-size:11px}
.tsh{margin:2px 2px 10px}.tsh h2{font-size:15px}
#page_ozet>.p2intro{display:none!important}

/* Risk renkleri: yumuşak dolgu + beyaz yazı */
#page_ra .rv.p0,#ra_m .rv.p0{background:#6fbf8e!important;color:#fff!important}
#page_ra .rv.p50,#ra_m .rv.p50{background:#f7ad3a!important;color:#fff!important}
#page_ra .rv.p100,#ra_m .rv.p100{background:#ec8d8d!important;color:#fff!important}
#page_ra .rv.p0,#page_ra .rv.p50,#page_ra .rv.p100,#ra_m .rv.p0,#ra_m .rv.p50,#ra_m .rv.p100{font-weight:500;font-size:12px;line-height:17px;padding:1px 7px;min-width:0!important;border-radius:6px;letter-spacing:.01em}
#ra_m .ra-rc .rv{font-size:15px!important}

#page_ra .ra-top{flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center}
#page_ra .ra-top .p2intro{justify-content:center;text-align:center;width:100%}
#page_ra .ra-top .p2intro p{margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
#page_ra .ra-kap{justify-content:center}
#page_ra .ra-srch{margin:0 auto;width:min(400px,100%)}#page_ra .ra-srch input{width:100%}
.tnote.oznote{font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.5;padding:8px 14px}

/* Not kutuları: Öne Çıkanlar ile aynı görünüm */
.tnote,.tnote.oznote{background:transparent;border:0;border-left:0;border-radius:0;padding:0;margin:0 0 14px;display:grid;gap:6px;color:var(--text);font-size:13px}
.tnote>div{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;background:#f1f5f9;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;padding:8px 12px;line-height:1.5;color:#1e293b}
.tnote>div:before{content:"";flex:0 0 8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#f59e0b;margin-top:6px}
.tnote div+div{margin-top:0}
.tem-tag{display:inline-block;margin-left:6px;padding:1px 8px;border-radius:999px;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:600;background:#eef2f7;color:#475569;vertical-align:1px;white-space:nowrap}
.kdesc{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;background:#f1f5f9;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;padding:9px 12px;margin:2px 0 12px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5;color:#1e293b}.kdesc:before{content:"";flex:0 0 8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#f59e0b;margin-top:6px}

/* Mobil: odaklanınca yakınlaşmayı önle, filtre penceresi alttan açılsın */
@media (max-width:900px),(pointer:coarse){
  input,select,textarea,th.fl input,th.fl select.chsel,.gtpop input[type=search],input[type=search]{font-size:16px!important}
  .gtpop{left:8px!important;right:8px!important;top:auto!important;bottom:calc(8px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))!important;min-width:0;max-width:none;width:auto;max-height:70vh;overflow:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;overscroll-behavior:contain;border-radius:16px;padding:12px}
  .gtpop .gtpi{padding:10px 8px}
  .gtpop .gtpi.mi input{width:20px;height:20px}
  html,body{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;text-size-adjust:100%}
  .tablewrap,.scroll{-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
}

/* Tasfiye kartları: satırlar (tarih/başlık, tutar, alt satır, alt bilgi) dört kartta aynı hizada */
.oztop3 .card.tc{display:grid!important;grid-row:span 4;grid-template-rows:subgrid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);row-gap:0;justify-items:center;align-items:start}
.oztop3 .card.tc>.tc-f{margin-top:0!important;align-self:stretch;justify-self:stretch;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center}
.oztop3 .card.tc .tc-fi{width:100%}
.oztop3 .card.tc>.tc-s{align-self:start}

/* Fon Listesi: sunum için biraz daha büyük yazı */
#page_fl .kpi .l{font-size:12.5px!important}
#page_fl .kpi .v{font-size:24px!important}
#page_fl .kpi .s{font-size:13px!important}
#page_fl .kpi.mini{padding:7px 14px!important}
#page_fl .kpi.mini .l{font-size:11.5px!important}
#page_fl .kpi.mini .v{font-size:21px!important}
#page_fl #fl_center .big{font-size:26px!important}
#page_fl #fl_center .sm{font-size:13.5px!important}
#page_fl h2{font-size:19px!important}
#page_fl #gt_flSum table{font-size:15.5px!important}
#page_fl #gt_flSum th{font-size:12.5px!important}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<aside id="side"><div><div class="brand"><div class="bl" title="Genel Bakış" style="cursor:pointer" onclick="const b=document.querySelector('#tabs [data-page=ozet]');if(b){b.click();window.scrollTo(0,0);}">F</div></div><nav class="tabs" id="tabs">
    <button data-page="ozet" class="on">Genel Bakış</button>
    <button data-page="fl">Fon Listesi</button>
    <button data-page="ds">Detaylı Arama</button>
    <button data-page="ys">Portföy Yönetim Şirketleri</button>
    <button data-page="yb">Yatırımcı ve Büyüklük</button>
    <button data-page="t1">Tasfiye Fonlar</button>
    <button data-page="kt">Konkordato - Temerrüt</button>
    <button data-page="ra">BİST Şirketler Risk Analizi</button>
  </nav></div></aside>
<div class="wrap">
  <div id="topbar"><div class="crumb"><b id="crumb">Genel Bakış</b></div><div class="tb-r" style="display:flex;align-items:center"><div class="sbox"><input id="gs" type="search" placeholder="Fon, şirket, hisse, tahvil ara… (ör. Vestel)" autocomplete="off"><kbd>↵</kbd><div id="gs_drop" class="gsdrop"></div></div></div></div>
  <header>
    <div>
      <h1>Fon Takip Dashboard</h1>
    </div>
  </header>

  

  <div class="controls" id="tasfCtrls" style="display:none">
    <div class="pop">
      <button class="btn primary" id="fundBtn"></button>
      <div class="popbox" id="fundBox">
        <input type="search" id="fundSearch" placeholder="Fon kodu veya adıyla arama…">
        <div class="row-actions"><button class="btn" id="fundAll">Tüm fonlar</button></div>
        <div class="flist" id="fundList"></div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <span class="ctrls" id="p1ctrls">
      <div class="seg" id="groupSeg">
        <button data-g="4" class="on">Varlık Türü</button>
        <button data-g="5">Ana Varlık Sınıfı</button>
      </div>
      <div class="seg" id="metricSeg">
        <button data-m="v" class="on">Tahmini Değer (TL)</button>
        <button data-m="w">Portföy Ağırlığı (%)</button>
      </div>
    </span>
    <button class="btn" id="resetBtn">Sıfırla</button>
  </div>


  <!-- ========== FON LİSTESİ ========== -->
  <section id="page_ozet">
    <div class="tnote oznote"><div>TLY ve TP2 fonlarının fiyat değişimleri TEFAS'ta yer almadığından bu fonlar için 16 Eylül portföy büyüklükleri kullanılmıştır.</div><div>30 Ekim itibarıyla olağanüstü tasfiye kapsamında Atlas, Pusula ve Tera Portföy fonlarında 29,3 milyar TL fon sahiplerinin hesaplarına yatırıldı.</div><div>4 Kasım itibarıyla olağanüstü tasfiye kapsamında para piyasası fonlarının ardından hisse senedi yoğun fonlarda da ödemeler başladı.</div></div>
    <div class="tsh" id="oz_tsh"></div>
    <div class="oztop3" id="oz_top"><div class="card" id="oz_tas1"></div><div class="card" id="oz_tas1b"></div><div class="card" id="oz_tas1c"></div><div class="card" id="oz_tas1d"></div></div>
    <div class="kpis" id="oz_kpis"></div>
    <div class="card ozcard" id="oz_od"></div>
    <div class="card ozcard" id="oz_ost"></div>
    <div class="card ozcard" id="oz_yp"></div>
    <div class="card ozcard" id="oz_var"></div>
    <div class="card ozcard" id="oz_yog"></div>
    <div class="grid2 ozmain"><div class="ozcol"><div class="card" id="oz_kt"></div></div><div class="card" id="oz_tas2"></div></div>
    <div class="ozfoot" id="oz_foot"></div>
  </section>

  <!-- ========== FON LİSTESİ ========== -->
  <section id="page_fl" style="display:none">
    <div class="p2intro"><div><h2>Fon Listesi</h2><p>Fonların varlık dağılımı (fon içindeki tutara göre). Pasta dilimine ya da tabloya tıklandığında hangi fonda ne olduğu görülür.</p><p class="disc">Not : Takip ve bilgilendirme amaçlıdır; yatırım tavsiyesi değildir.</p><p class="disc">Veri notu: Tera Portföy fonlarından TLY ve TP2 için TEFAS üzerinde fon fiyat bilgisi yayından kaldırıldığından fiyat 0 olarak görünmektedir; bu nedenle ilgili fonlarda KAP’ta ilan edilen son portföy büyüklüğü/ işlem gördüğü son fiyat bazlı değerleme esas alınmıştır. Pusula Portföy fonlarında ise güncel değerleme tarihi itibarıyla TEFAS verileriyle uyumlu şekilde değer değişimleri yansıtılabilmiştir.</p></div>
      <button class="btn" id="fl_reset">Filtreleri sıfırla</button></div>
    <div class="card fbar">
      <div class="seg" id="fl_tasf"><button data-fltasf="" class="on">Tüm fonlar</button><button data-fltasf="EVET">Tasfiye</button><button data-fltasf="HAYIR">Tasfiye değil</button></div>
      <select id="fl_kat"></select>
      <select id="fl_yon"></select>
      <input type="search" id="fl_q" placeholder="Fon, kod veya şirket adıyla arama…">
      <div class="seg" id="fl_view"><button data-flview="grup" class="on">Varlık Grubu</button><button data-flview="sinif">Varlık Sınıfı</button></div>
    </div>
    <div class="kpis" id="fl_kpis"></div>
    <div class="grid">
      <div class="card"><h2 id="fl_dtitle">Dağılım</h2>
        <div class="donutwrap"><svg class="donut" id="fl_donut" viewBox="0 0 300 300"></svg><div class="center" id="fl_center"></div></div>
        <div class="note" id="fl_note"></div></div>
      <div class="card"><h2 id="fl_tableTitle">Özet</h2><div id="gt_flSum"></div>
        <div class="note">Bir satıra ya da dilime tıklandığında, aşağıda o kalemi tutan fonlar listelenir.</div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="card" id="fl_detail_card"><div id="fl_dhead"></div><div id="gt_flDet"></div></div>
    <div class="card" id="fl_kal" style="display:none"></div>
  </section>

  <!-- ========== PORTFÖY YÖNETİM ŞİRKETLERİ ========== -->
  <section id="page_ds" style="display:none">
    <div class="p2intro"><div><h2>Detaylı Arama</h2><p>Fonları portföylerindeki kod, ISIN ve varlık türleriyle bulun.</p></div><button class="btn" data-dsreset="1">⟳ Yenile</button></div>
    <div class="card dscard">
      <div class="dshead"><div class="dst"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 21v-7M4 10V3M12 21v-9M12 8V3M20 21v-5M20 12V3M1 14h6M9 8h6M17 16h6"/></svg><h2>Portföyde Ne Arıyorsunuz?</h2></div><span class="gray">Örneğin TP2’yi içeren, AKBNK’yi içermeyen fonlar.</span></div>
      <div class="dsrow"><label class="grow">Ürün Ara<input id="ds_q" type="search" placeholder="Ürün, kıymet ya da ihraççı adı / kodu yazın (ör. Vestel, Akbank, AKBNK)" autocomplete="off"></label><label>Ürün Türü<select id="ds_qg"></select></label></div>
      <div class="dsrow">
        <label>Koşul<select id="ds_t"><option value="1">İçersin</option><option value="0">İçermesin</option></select></label>
        <label>Aranacak Alan<select id="ds_f"><option value="g">Varlık Türü</option><option value="kod">Fon Kodu</option><option value="k">Kod / ISIN</option><option value="m">Kıymet / İhraççı</option></select></label>
        <label class="grow"><span id="ds_vl">Varlık Türü</span><span id="ds_vh"></span></label>
        <button class="add" data-dsadd="1">+ Kural Ekle</button>
      </div>
      <div class="gray" id="ds_hint"></div>
      <div id="ds_rules"></div>
      <div class="dsline"><span>Eşleşme ve Kapsam</span></div>
      <div class="dsrow">
        <label>İçersin Kurallarının Eşleşmesi<select id="ds_m"><option value="all">Tümü Eşleşsin</option><option value="any">Herhangi Biri Eşleşsin</option></select></label>
        <label>Portföy Şirketi<select id="ds_c"></select></label>
        <label class="chk"><input type="checkbox" id="ds_z" checked> Sıfır Paylı Rapor Kayıtlarını Dahil Et</label>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="card"><div class="detailhead"><div><h2>Sonuç Fonları <span class="dscnt" id="ds_n"></span></h2><p class="gray" style="margin:4px 0 0">Portföy raporundaki kıymetlere göre eşleşen fonlar. Detay için bir fon seçin.</p></div><span style="display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap"><button class="ghost" id="ds_turbtn" data-gtpop="dsF|tur">Varlık Türü Filtresi ▾</button><button class="add" data-dsxls="1">⭳ Excel İndir</button></span></div><div id="gt_dsF"></div></div>
  </section>
  <section id="page_ys" style="display:none">
    <div class="card" id="ys_cards"><div class="detailhead"><h2>Şirket Kartları</h2><button class="btn" id="ys_more" data-yscardmore="1">Tümünü Göster</button></div><div class="cgrid" id="ys_cgrid"></div></div>
    <div class="p2intro"><div><h2>Portföy Yönetim Şirketleri</h2><p>Şirket bazında fon sayısı, toplam fon büyüklüğü ve yatırımcı sayısı. Grafiklere, listeye ya da tabloya tıklandığında şirketin fonları ve varlık dağılımı görülür.</p><p class="disc">Veri notu: Tera Portföy fonlarından TLY ve TP2 için TEFAS üzerinde fon fiyat bilgisi yayından kaldırıldığından fiyat 0 olarak görünmektedir; bu nedenle ilgili fonlarda KAP’ta ilan edilen son portföy büyüklüğü/ işlem gördüğü son fiyat bazlı değerleme esas alınmıştır. Pusula Portföy fonlarında ise güncel değerleme tarihi itibarıyla TEFAS verileriyle uyumlu şekilde değer değişimleri yansıtılabilmiştir.</p></div>
      <button class="btn" id="ys_reset">Filtreleri sıfırla</button></div>
    <div class="card fbar">
      <div class="seg" id="ys_tasf"><button data-ystasf="" class="on">Tüm fonlar</button><button data-ystasf="EVET">Yalnızca tasfiye fonları</button><button data-ystasf="HAYIR">Tasfiye olmayanlar</button></div>
      <div class="seg" id="ys_tur"><button data-ystur="" class="on">Tüm şirketler</button><button data-ystur="Portföy yönetim şirketi">Portföy yönetim</button><button data-ystur="Emeklilik şirketi">Emeklilik</button></div>
      <select id="ys_kat"></select>
      <input type="search" id="ys_q" placeholder="Şirket adıyla arama…">
    </div>
    <div class="kpis" id="ys_kpis"></div>
    <div class="grid2">
      <div class="card"><div class="detailhead"><h2 id="ys_topTitle">İlk 15 şirket</h2>
        <div class="seg" id="ys_metric"><button data-ysmetric="tot" class="on">Büyüklük</button><button data-ysmetric="yat">Yatırımcı</button><button data-ysmetric="n">Fon sayısı</button><button data-ysmetric="avg">Ort. fon</button><button data-ysmetric="perInv">Kişi başı</button></div></div>
        <div id="ys_top"></div><div class="note">Bir çubuğa tıklandığında şirket detayı açılır.</div></div>
      <div class="card"><h2>Pazar payı (ilk 10 şirket)</h2>
        <div class="donutwrap"><svg class="donut" id="ys_donut" viewBox="0 0 300 300"></svg><div class="center" id="ys_center"></div></div>
        <div class="legend" id="ys_legend"></div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="grid2">
      <div class="card"><h2>Varlık dağılımı — ilk 12 şirket</h2><div id="ys_stack"></div><div class="legendrow" id="ys_stackLegend"></div>
        <div class="note">Her çubuk şirketin fonlarındaki varlık gruplarının tutar payını (%100) gösterir. Segmentin üzerine gelindiğinde tutar görünür; çubuğa tıklandığında şirket seçilir.</div></div>
      <div class="card"><h2>Şirketler Görünümü</h2><div id="ys_bubble"></div><div class="legendrow" id="ys_bubbleLegend"></div>
        <div class="note">Sağ üstteki şirketler hem çok fonlu hem büyüktür. Bir balona tıklandığında şirket seçilir.</div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="card"><h2>Portföy yönetim şirketleri listesi</h2><div id="gt_ysT"></div>
      <div class="note">Pazar payı ve kümülatif pay, filtrelenmiş şirketlerin toplamı üzerinden hesaplanır. Yatırımcı sayısı, fon bazlı yatırımcı sayılarının toplamıdır (aynı kişi birden fazla fonda olabilir). Tür, şirket adından türetilmiştir.</div></div>
    <div class="card" id="ys_detail_card" style="margin-top:16px"><div id="ys_detail"></div></div>
  </section>

  <!-- ========== YATIRIMCI SAYISI VE BÜYÜKLÜK ========== -->
  <section id="page_yb" style="display:none">
    <div class="p2intro"><div><h2>Yatırımcı ve Büyüklük</h2><p>Fon bazında güncel (5 Kasım) fon büyüklüğü ve yatırımcı sayısı.</p></div>
      <button class="btn" id="yb_reset">Filtreleri sıfırla</button></div>
    <div class="card noteBox" id="yb_notes"></div>
    <div class="card fbar">
      <div class="seg" id="yb_tasf"><button data-ybtasf="" class="on">Tüm fonlar</button><button data-ybtasf="EVET">Tasfiye</button><button data-ybtasf="HAYIR">Tasfiye değil</button></div>
      <select id="yb_kat"></select><select id="yb_yon"></select>
      <select id="yb_size"><option value="">Tüm büyüklükler</option><option value="a">&lt; 10 Mn ₺</option><option value="b">10–100 Mn ₺</option><option value="c">100 Mn – 1 Mr ₺</option><option value="d">1–10 Mr ₺</option><option value="e">&gt; 10 Mr ₺</option></select>
      <input type="search" id="yb_q" placeholder="Fon, kod veya şirket adıyla arama…">
      <div class="chiprow" id="yb_chips"><button class="chipbtn on" data-ybchip="">Tümü</button><button class="chipbtn" data-ybchip="tasf">Yalnızca tasfiye</button><button class="chipbtn" data-ybchip="y0">Yatırımcı sayısı 0</button></div>
    </div>
    <div class="kpis" id="yb_kpis"></div>
    <div class="grid2" style="grid-template-columns:1fr">
      <div class="card"><div class="detailhead"><h2 id="yb_topTitle">En yüksek 20 fon</h2>
        <div class="seg" id="yb_metric"><button data-ybmetric="tut1" class="on">Büyüklük</button><button data-ybmetric="yat">Yatırımcı</button><button data-ybmetric="perInv">Kişi başı</button></div></div>
        <div id="yb_top"></div><div class="note">İlk 10 fon görünür; listenin devamı sağdaki çubukla aşağı kaydırılarak görülebilir. Bir çubuğa tıklandığında fon, Fon Listesi sayfasında açılır.</div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="card" style="margin-bottom:16px"><h2>Büyüklük aralığına göre fon sayısı</h2><div id="yb_sizes"></div><div class="note">Bir aralığa tıklandığında tablo o aralığa daralır; tekrar tıklandığında filtre kalkar.</div></div>
    <div class="card"><div id="gt_ybT"></div><div class="note">Satıra tıklandığında fon, Fon Listesi sayfasında açılır.</div></div>
  </section>

  <!-- ========== KONKORDATO - TEMERRÜT ========== -->
  <section id="page_kt" style="display:none">
    <div class="p2intro"><div><h2>Konkordato - Temerrüt</h2><p>Liste, konkordato/temerrüt sürecindeki şirketlerin ve Genel Bakış’taki ödeme takviminde yer alan, tahvil/bono ödemesini yapamayan şirketlerin kâğıtlarını kapsar. ISIN’a ya da ihraççıya tıklandığında, tahvil/bonoların hangi fonun portföyünde yer aldığı görülür; ihraççıya ya da itfa çeyreğine tıklandığında liste daralır, fona tıklandığında Fon Listesi açılır.</p><p class="disc">Bilgi notu: Tahvil/bono ödemelerini gerçekleştiremeyen şirketlerin borçlanma araçlarına sahip olan fonlar, bu menkul kıymetler için %100 zarar karşılığı ayırması sebebiyle KAP raporlarında ilgili menkul kıymetlere ilişkin portföy büyüklükleri 0 gözükmektedir.</p></div><button class="btn" data
